failure: Failure: The redundant-generator construction shows a failure of deleting the support of a relator defect as a repair method; replacing the redundant generator by I repairs that tuple. The source explicitly does not claim a counterexample to flexible stability. The exact-corner-to-strict-repair observation only blocks one route to bypassing the cited strict obstruction.
interface: Interface: The conjugation-gap assumption is explicit and applies to every traceless matrix. The representation is exact, finite-dimensional, and irreducible; P has rank k and the normalized metric denominator remains n. A property-(T) application needs its fixed Kazhdan-set gap and, for an asymptotic family, unbounded irreducible dimensions.
